top_signals.title: Low Expectations for US-China AI Talks
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Sunny Bangia says markets expect low initial outcomes from upcoming US-China AI discussions, with progress likely limited to safety and cybersecurity cooperation. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: NSE’s $2.4 Billion IPO Gets Subdued Demand From Retail Crowd
top_signals.summary: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.’s $2.4 billion initial public offering drew subdued demand particularly from retail investors as valuation concerns continued to weigh on one of the largest stock market debuts in India’s history.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
